definitions.explanation: A novelist whose books, such as Norwegian Wood and 1Q84, are translated into dozens of languages. His dreamlike stories, references to jazz and Western pop, and plain style have made him the most widely read living Japanese writer abroad.

{村上春樹|むらかみはるき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}まれている→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Murakami Haruki's books are read all over the world.

examples.english: Every autumn, people talk about whether Murakami Haruki will win the Nobel Prize.

notes:
Readers often call him simply {村上|むらかみ}さん or {春樹|はるき}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ハルキスト: a devoted Murakami fan
- ノルウェイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧: Norwegian Wood (1987), his breakthrough bestseller
- {村上|むらかみ}ワールド: the recognizable world of his fiction

CULTURAL NOTE:
Each October, fans gather to await the Nobel Prize in Literature announcement, and the media discuss his chances every year.
